notes: June 2026 reports (Times of India, DD India) quote Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw outlining plans for an AI data centre at MNIT Jaipur alongside quantum/semiconductor labs and a medical hub; no capacity, site or timeline disclosed - planning-stage lead. Policy context: Rajasthan Data Centre Policy-2025 (announced in state budget 2024-25, published Apr 2025) targets ~Rs 20,000 crore DC investment over five years with incentives (annual asset creation incentive Rs 10-20 crore for 10 yrs, sunrise incentive, interest subsidy, power/wheeling exemptions) - policy ambition, not project capacity.
